# `languages/ci/nix:T157`: a string whose first line -- after nix strips its
# indent -- is a shebang holds the language that line names, under ANY
# attribute. The dialect is the interpreter's; a hole in the interpreter
# path does not hide its basename.
environment.etc.X11/xinit/xinitrc.text | '' | sh | - | "\n    #!/bin/sh\n    xrdb -merge \"$HOME/.Xresources\"\n    xsetroot -cursor_name left_ptr\n    setxkbmap -option ctrl:nocaps\n    xset r rate 200 40\n    exec i3\n  "
hooks.text | " | bash | ${pkgs.bash} | "#!${pkgs.bash}/bin/bash\\nexec true\\n"
